events.name: Chicago White Sox at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery hit a go-ahead double in the eighth inning, Jacob Gonzalez drove in three runs and the Chicago White Sox beat the Baltimore Orioles 8-2 on Monday night in the opener of their series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montgomery hits the go-ahead double and Gonzalez has 3 RBIs as the White Sox down the Orioles 8-2

headlines.description: — Esmerlyn Valdez and Jared Triolo both hit home runs to help the Pittsburgh Pirates escape an early five-run deficit, and Endy Rodriguez closed the deal with a three-run homer in the ninth for an 11-7 win over the Philadelphia Phillies on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Valdez, Triolo and Rodriguez homer for Pirates in 11-7 win over Phillies

headlines.description: — Cameron Cauley tripled in the seventh inning for his first hit in his major league debut before scoring the go-ahead run on a single by Nicky Lopez to help the Texas Rangers beat the Cleveland Indians 6-3 on Monday night for their fifth straight...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cameron Cauley makes splash in big league debut as Rangers top Guardians 6-3 for 5th straight win

events.name: Detroit Tigers at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Casey Mize matched a career high with 10 strikeouts over seven innings and the Detroit Tigers capitalized on shoddy defense by the slumping New York Yankees in a 7-3 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Casey Mize matches career high with 10 strikeouts as Tigers beat sloppy Yankees 7-3

events.name: New York Mets at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — George Springer capitalized on two miscues to circle the bases with a Little League homer, Trey Yesavage pitched into the seventh inning and the...
headlines.shortLinkText: George Springer and Blue Jays capitalize on Mets' mistakes in 2-1 win to snap 6-game skid

events.name: Washington Nationals at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Wilson Contreras hit a three-run homer, Caleb Durbin added a home run of his own, and the Boston Red Sox beat the Washington Nationals 6-3 on Monday to extend their winning streak to a season-high five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Contreras and Durbin homer as Red Sox extend win streak to 5 games with 6-3 win over Nationals

headlines.description: — Joey Ortiz had a two-run homer with two outs in the eighth inning to give the Milwaukee Brewers a 5-3 comeback victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ortiz homer gives Brewers 5-3 comeback win over Reds

events.name: San Diego Padres at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Seiya Suzuki hit a game-ending single off Mason Miller in the ninth inning, and the Chicago Cubs beat the San Diego Padres 3-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Suzuki hits game-ending single off Miller as the Cubs beat the Padres 3-2

headlines.description: — Royce Lewis and Victor Caratini hit back-to-back homers, Zebby Matthews pitched seven stingy innings and the Minnesota Twins held off a late rally by the Houston Astros for a 5-4 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Twins hit 3 homers to back Matthews, then hold off Astros rally in 9th for 5-4 victory

headlines.description: — Griffin Conine hit a three-run homer off the third-deck facade in right field and righty Sandy Alcantara improved to 6-0 in June as the Miami Marlins rallied for a 10-7 win over the
headlines.shortLinkText: Conine smashes 3-run homer, Alcantara improves to 6-0 in June as Marlins beat Rockies 10-7

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Cole Young hit two home runs to back eight strong innings from George Kirby as the Seattle Mariners came from behind to beat the Los Angeles Angels 6-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: George Kirby goes 8 innings and Cole Young homers twice as Mariners top Angels 6-2

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani hit a three-run homer to support Eric Lauer in his conventional return to the starting rotation as the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Athletics 9-4 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shohei Ohtani homers to lead Dodgers' offensive onslaught in 9-4 win over A's

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Arizona Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Geraldo Perdomo hit a three-run double, Ketel Marte and Nolan Arenado added solo homers and the Arizona Diamondbacks stayed undefeated against the San Francisco Giants this season, holding on for a 5-4 win on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Perdomo hits 3-run double, Rodriguez deals, D-backs top Giants again in 5-4 win
